description: Screen the WHOLE ETF universe by numeric rules and fund attributes in one pass — expense ratio, AUM, yield, trailing returns, volatility, liquidity, top-10 concentration, fund age and holdings count — combined with issuer, index, domicile, UCITS status, distribution policy, currency hedging and constituent look-through (holdingSearch finds funds by what they hold). Prefer this over search_etfs for any "cheapest / largest / best performing / most liquid" question: search_etfs only filters a bounded candidate scan, while this evaluates the full universe and reports evaluatedCount and matchCount. Percentages are percentage points. This is the heaviest read in the API and is metered against a small per-day action budget, so build one well-specified screen rather than probing repeatedly. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

assetClass.description: Exact asset-class group: EQUITY, FIXED_INCOME, COMMODITY, REAL_ESTATE, MULTI_ASSET, CASH, CURRENCY, DIGITAL_ASSETS, ALTERNATIVES or OTHER.

benchmarkSearch.description: Substring match on the stated benchmark name.

category.description: Exact category string. Call get_etf_filter_options for the valid values; a wrong guess silently returns zero rows.

currency.description: Exact trading currency, e.g. EUR, USD, GBX.

currencyHedged.description: HEDGED selects funds labelled currency-hedged. NOT_LABELLED_HEDGED selects funds not so labelled — absence of a label is not proof a fund is unhedged.

distributionPolicy.description: Accumulating (reinvests income) or distributing (pays it out) — the usual first cut for a European investor.

exchange.description: Exact listing exchange, e.g. XETRA, LSE, "NYSE ARCA".

holdingMinWeightPct.description: Minimum constituent weight in percentage points for holdingSearch to count as a match.

holdingMode.description: INCLUDES keeps funds holding the constituent. EXCLUDES keeps only funds with a holdings snapshot that confirms absence — funds with no snapshot are dropped, never assumed clean.

holdingSearch.description: Look-through filter: find funds by a CONSTITUENT ticker or company name, e.g. "NVDA" or "NVIDIA". Only funds with a stored holdings snapshot can match.

includeSecondary.description: Include secondary venue listings of the same fund. Default false — one row per fund's primary listing.

indexKey.description: Exact tracked-index key, e.g. SP500, MSCI_WORLD, NASDAQ100. Use get_etf_index_group to compare every fund on one index instead.

issuer.description: Substring match on the fund family/issuer, e.g. "iShares", "Amundi", "Vanguard".

marketDevelopment.description: Exact market-development classification, e.g. developed vs emerging.

order.description: Sort direction. Nulls always sort last regardless of direction.

rules.description: Numeric rules. A fund with no value for a ruled metric never matches that rule.

groupId.description: Rules with the same groupId are ANDed; different groups are ORed.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Use '..' for an inclusive between range with valueMax.

unit.description: Optional money unit for money metrics: '', K, M, B or T.

value.description: Threshold. For money metrics combine with unit for K/M/B/T scaling.

valueMax.description: Upper bound for '..' range rules. Ignored for other operators.

search.description: Free-text match on ticker, fund name or ISIN. Omit to screen the whole universe.

sortBy.description: Sort field applied to the returned rows.

ucitsStatus.description: UCITS restricts to wrappers a European retail investor can actually buy.

name: screen_etfs
title: Screen ETFs
